senses.gloss:
--four, ब्रह्मचर्य, गृहस्त, वानप्रस्थ and भिक्षुक; duties:--ब्रह्मचर्य: study by service to गुरु and begging food; गृहस्त: the source and strength of all आश्रमस्; those celibate do penance, sacrifice, give birth to sons, perform श्राद्ध, learn the Vedas and give gifts of food; दाराग्नि, guests, sacrifice and श्राद्ध; become देवपितृस्; वानप्रस्थ: bathe in morning and evening and on ceremonials; eating of fruits and roots, non-theft, purity, sympathy and non-injury--ten kinds of धर्म; भिक्षु: दण्डि, मेखलि, and lying in ground floor.
1: भा. VII. १२. 1-३१; १३. 1-१०; १४. to the end; M. १४१. ६१-2; २४८. १६; वा. 8. १७७-88; २३. ८२; ३३. २७; ५६. ६८; ६१. १६७; Vi. III. 8. २०; ch. 9 (whole).
A reference to the fifth आश्रम;
2: Br. II. १६. १५; III. १५. ३७-8.
will be lost at the end of Kaliyuga when anarchy prevails.
3: M. ४७. २५७.
--a group of sages of कश्यप gotra. M. १९९. 2.
